messages:
erin (eng-security): quick alert 1: upstream pushed a glibc patch addressing CVE-2026-2501 that breaks some OpenSSL FIPS builds when combined with our debian-14 base. we need an emergency base-image rebuild + KMS signing review and an audit backfill for recent iam changes that widened builder privileges.

paul (eng-infra): ack. propose a 45m maintenance window tonight 01:00 UTC. infra will run auto-rebuild -> tag staging -> cosign with KMS wrapped key. who owns the audit correlation for the builder role change?

vera (sec): sec will take audit correlation. note: last week ops temporarily granted iam.serviceAccounts.actAs to build-runner@redwood to fix a blocker. i want a backfill covering 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z. also prefer ephemeral unwrap (KMS short-lived) instead of restoring long-lived perms.

diego (eng-runtime): runtime checklist for rebuilt image:
- rebuild debian-14 with patched glibc + pinned openssl-fips
- Dockerfile: set no_new_privs, drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_MKNOD
- containerd: disable userns remap for this image and enable seccomp profile strict
- add attestation step: wait for SBOM diff approval before pushing to prod

erin (eng-security): pipeline must emit structured audit events for: build:start, build:sbom, image:sign, key:unwrap. format simple JSON lines is fine. include fields: actor, event, image, key, ts, rbac_delta if any manual grants.

paul (eng-infra): infra tasks:
- create calendar window and freeze builders for cut
- cosign via KMS: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/wrap
- tag pushed images as staging+sha and write audit JSON to gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/audit.jsonl
- expose quick-revoke endpoint POST /registry/v1/revoke {"image":"..."}

vera (sec): audit query i'll run for backfill:
```
logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"build-runner@redwood" OR protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"ops@redwood"
protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy" OR "google.iam.admin.v1.Binding")
timestamp>="2026-03-22T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-03-24T00:00:00Z"
```
correlate with gs://redwood-build-logs/*/rbld-* and KMS audit logs for projects/redwood/keyRings/build.

deploy-bot: CI: rebuild queued: id=rbld-2945-stg initiator=erin. watch: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/rbld-2945-stg

paul (eng-infra): build job started. builder image=debian-14+pached-glibc. pipeline will write audit JSON lines to GCS.

diego (eng-runtime): post-build staging smoke to run:
```
kubectl run glibc-smoke --image=registry.staging.redwood/base:glibc-patch --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false}}]}}'
kubectl exec -it glibc-smoke -- openssl version -a
```
also start runtime-fuzzer for 20m against canary pods; auto-rollback on >2 crashes in 5m.

erin (eng-security): vuln triage: if SBOM diff shows openssl or libcrypto upgrade regressions, file sec/image-rebuild with priority=high and attach failing test logs.

deploy-bot: job rbld-2945-stg completed: status=SUCCESS duration=16m artifacts: gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/ - triggered by erin

vera (sec): kicking audit backfill now. i'll paste CSV of correlated events in ~10m. please ensure build logs ACLs allow sec team read (paul).

paul (eng-infra): granted read to security-team@redwood on gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/. audit JSON is at gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/audit.jsonl

diego (eng-runtime): staging canary up. running eBPF probes for prctl/ptrace and watch OpenSSL FIPS self-tests. will escalate on >1 FIPS failure or any kernel oops.

erin (eng-security): quick note: if any artifacts are found signed by a principal that was granted perms during the backfill window, we must mark them untrusted and run a rbld-resign flow. record decision in incident runbook.

vera (sec): audit correlation complete. results: one sign event during window by build-runner@redwood at 2026-03-23T03:11:42Z. correlating with GCS build logs now to see which artifact. attaching CSV to ticket.

erin (eng-security): ok infra, please run rbld-resign for the affected artifact and flip registry revoke flag until resign completes. owners: paul=infra & revoke/resign, diego=runtime canary & rollback, vera=KMS + audit correlation, erin=sec lead + incident runbook.

paul (eng-infra): running rbld-resign now: rbld-resign-2945 -> reads from gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/artifacts/, re-signs with ephemeral KMS key, updates registry entry. POST /registry/v1/revoke executed temporarily.

diego (eng-runtime): canary reports: OpenSSL FIPS self-tests passed, no kernel oops in first 12m. monitoring hooks remain active.

paul (eng-infra): rbld-resign completed: new signature applied, registry revoke cleared after verification. logs: gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-2945-stg/resign-log.txt

vera (sec): audit CSV and resign logs uploaded to ticket. no other anomalous sign events found. adding a runbook entry to disallow granting iam.serviceAccounts.actAs to build-runner without pre-approval.

erin (eng-security): closing the loop 1. will update incident-runbook and the rebuild playbook with the exact queries and the quick-revoke endpoint. thanks all. :lock:
